# fjordrun_team (Resource)

A team: the billing and ownership boundary of projects. Creating one needs a personal access token (team API tokens can't), and you become its owner. A team starts on the Trial plan; plans change in the dashboard. A team can only be deleted once it has no projects and no active subscription.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fjordrun_team" "acme" {
  name = "Acme"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Team name (1-100 characters).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `founding_member` (Boolean) Whether the team has founding member benefits.
- `id` (String) Team ID.
- `namespace` (String) The team's Kubernetes namespace.
- `plan` (String) Current plan: `trial`, `hobby`, `pro` or `enterprise`.
- `role` (String) The caller's role in the team.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe name, generated from the first name.
- `status` (String) `active` or `suspended` (out of credit or over the spending limit).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# by team ID
terraform import fjordrun_team.acme 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111
```
